# Footnotes

Simple reference[^1] in a sentence.

Multiple references[^1][^note] in one paragraph, and a long one[^long].

Footnotes can appear in lists:

- item with a footnote[^list]
- plain item

And in **bold text with a marker[^1]** too.

[^1]: The first footnote.

[^note]: A named footnote with `code` and a [link](https://example.com).

[^long]: A longer footnote definition that spans
    multiple lines and contains a second paragraph.

    The second paragraph of the footnote.

[^list]: Referenced from a list item.

## After the definitions

Text following the footnote definitions[^note].
